standard.summary: 选择训练的执行核心引擎。standard 使用标准 PyTorch 训练循环；turbo 启用 TurboCore 加速路径（实验性）；auto 自动选择。
standard.effect: standard 最稳定。turbo 可能提供额外加速但仍处于实验阶段。auto 让系统根据硬件和配置自动选择。
standard.whenToUse: 大多数用户保持 standard。开发者或想尝试加速的用户可选 turbo（需要 turbocore_allow_fallback=True）。
standard.avoidWhen: 生产训练建议用 standard。turbo 的某些特性可能不完全验证。

standard_en.summary: Picks the execution core for training. standard uses the standard PyTorch training loop; turbo enables the TurboCore acceleration path (experimental); auto chooses for you.
standard_en.effect: standard is the most stable. turbo may go faster but is still experimental. auto lets the system choose from the hardware and configuration.
standard_en.whenToUse: Most users should stay on standard. Developers, or anyone wanting to try the acceleration, can pick turbo (which needs turbocore_allow_fallback=True).
standard_en.avoidWhen: standard is recommended for production training; some of turbo's features are not fully verified.

advanced.principle: TurboCore 是一个优化的执行路径，可能包含：融合 kernel、自定义 CUDA 算子、异步数据管线等。turbocore_features 可以细粒度启用/禁用特定 TurboCore 特性。turbocore_strict=True 时在 TurboCore 不可用时直接失败而非回退。
advanced.intervention: entry_train.py 根据 execution_core 选择执行路径。
advanced.expectedImpact: turbo 在支持的硬件上可能提速 10-20%，但稳定性不如 standard。
advanced.tradeoffs: turbocore_allow_fallback=True 在 turbo 不可用时自动回退到 standard。

advanced_en.principle: TurboCore is an optimized execution path that may include fused kernels, custom CUDA ops, and asynchronous data pipelines. turbocore_features can enable/disable specific TurboCore features finely. With turbocore_strict=True, TurboCore unavailability fails outright instead of falling back.
advanced_en.intervention: entry_train.py selects the execution path per execution_core.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: turbo may speed up 10-20% on supporting hardware but is less stable than standard.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: turbocore_allow_fallback=True auto-falls back to standard when turbo is unavailable.
